================================================================================
Third-party components
================================================================================

Orbit integrates with, extends, or vendors portions of the following
third-party projects. Each component is redistributed under its own
license, which governs that component's use regardless of Orbit's
top-level Apache-2.0 license. See the per-scenario directories for
verbatim license text where required by the upstream license.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Inspect AI (plugin host)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai
    License:  MIT
    Orbit extends Inspect AI via its documented plugin architecture
    (@task / @solver / @scorer / @agent / @tool decorators and entry-point
    discovery). No Inspect AI source is vendored in this repository.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. inspect_evals — SWE-Bench vendored modules
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals
    License:  MIT  (see orbit/scenarios/coding/swe_bench/_vendor/LICENSE.inspect_evals)
    Vendored paths:
        orbit/scenarios/coding/swe_bench/_vendor/build_images.py
        orbit/scenarios/coding/swe_bench/_vendor/scorers.py
        orbit/scenarios/coding/swe_bench/_vendor/swe_bench_tasks.py
    Original authors: Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Alexander Wettig,
    Shunyu Yao, Kexin Pei, Ofir Press, Karthik Narasimhan
    (https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06770).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. τ²-bench — vendored domain data
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench
    License:  MIT  (see orbit/scenarios/customer_service/tau2/LICENSE.tau2)
    Vendored paths: orbit/scenarios/customer_service/tau2/data/{airline,retail,telecom}/

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. ConVerse — vendored benchmark data (normalized derivative)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/amrgomaaelhady/ConVerse
    License:  MIT  (see orbit/scenarios/customer_service/converse/LICENSE.converse)
    Vendored paths: orbit/scenarios/customer_service/converse/data/
    The JSON files under data/ are a normalized derivative of the
    upstream ConVerse benchmark data, redistributed under the upstream
    MIT license. The converse scenario code itself is Orbit-original
    (Apache-2.0).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. BrowserART — upstream datasets are NOT redistributed
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/scaleapi/browser-art
    License:  CC BY-NC-ND 4.0  (per the upstream LICENSE file; upstream
              README says MIT but the LICENSE file controls).
    Orbit does not redistribute BrowserART's upstream datasets
    (hbb.json, hbb_benign.json, hbb/behaviors.json). Users fetch them
    separately; see orbit/scenarios/browser/browserart/data/README.md.
    The file orbit/scenarios/browser/browserart/data/hbb_benign_custom.json
    is Orbit-original content and is licensed under Apache-2.0 with
    the rest of Orbit.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. RedCode-Gen — upstream stubs are NOT redistributed
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/AI-secure/RedCode
    License:  Upstream repository has no LICENSE file. The companion
              paper (Guo et al., NeurIPS 2024 D&B) declares the
              dataset as CC BY 4.0 but the code portion is undeclared.
    Orbit does not redistribute RedCode-Gen's malware-stub function
    signatures. Users fetch them separately; see
    orbit/scenarios/coding/redcode_gen/data/README.md.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. OSWorld / OS-Harm (API-only, via pip extra)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld
    License:  Apache-2.0
    Orbit depends on this via the `osworld` optional extra and does not
    redistribute upstream source.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. BigCodeBench (API-only, via pip extra)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Upstream: https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodebench
    License:  Apache-2.0
    Orbit depends on this via the `bigcodebench` optional extra and
    does not redistribute upstream source.
